summary: Steven Young posted in January 2025 calling for a ceasefire and praising Hamas as 'brave heroes' and 'brave and capable resistance,' ending with 'Free Palestine!' By June 2026 he stated explicit support for BDS against Israel and was certified AIPAC and J Street free by Track J Street. His personal statements and BDS stance place him firmly in opposition to Israeli military action and the US backing behind it.
